definitions.explanation: Abbreviation of {女子大生|じょしだいせい}, referring to female university students.

examples.japanese: JD⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バイト→バイト：06955_baito⟧
examples.english: A part-time job popular among female college students.
My older sister is a female college student now.

examples.japanese: JD{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ファッション→ファッション：11167_fasshon⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{売|う}れている→売れる：02012_ureru⟧。
examples.english: Fashion magazines for female college students are selling well.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Abbreviation of ⟦{女子大生|じょしだいせい}→女子大生：23937_joshidaisei⟧ (female college student). J = ⟦{女子|じょし}→女子：03350_joshi⟧ (female), D = {大生|だいせい} (college student).

REGISTER:
Informal internet and youth slang. Not used in formal writing or polite conversation. Common in marketing, social media, and casual speech among younger speakers.

RELATED ABBREVIATIONS:
- JK: ⟦{女子高生|じょしこうせい}→女子高生：12381_joshikousei⟧ (high school girl)
- JC: ⟦{女子中学生|じょしちゅうがくせい}→女子中学生：23376_joshichuugakusei⟧ (middle school girl)
- JD1〜JD4: indicates year in university (1st through 4th year)

USAGE:
There is no widely used male equivalent abbreviation. Male college students are simply called ⟦{大学生|だいがくせい}→大学生：01653_daigakusei⟧.
